# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CashInConfig = {}

-- Resolve a verified sound id from the GameAssets sound table (Coin, Pop, ...).
-- Falls back to the given id if GameAssets or the entry is missing.
local function normalizeId(value: any): string?
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(math.floor(value))
	elseif type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveSound(name: string, fallback: string): string
	local resolved: string? = nil
	pcall(function()
		local moduleScript = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameAssets") or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets", 5)
		if not moduleScript then
			return
		end
		local ga = require(moduleScript)
		if type(ga) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local tbl = ga.Sounds or ga.SOUNDS or ga.sounds or ga.SoundIds or ga.SOUND_IDS or ga.soundIds
		if type(tbl) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local entry = tbl[name]
		if type(entry) == "table" then
			resolved = normalizeId(entry.id or entry.Id or entry.ID or entry.SoundId or entry.soundId or entry[1])
		else
			resolved = normalizeId(entry)
		end
	end)
	return resolved or fallback
end
